_about: W. J. M. Starkie (1860-1920), Fellow of Trinity College, Dublin, President of Queen's College, Galway, and Resident Commissioner of National Education in Ireland: editions of Aristophanes with English commentary, raw IA. The Wasps (Macmillan, 1897), with introduction, metrical analysis, critical notes and commentary; The Acharnians (1909) and The Clouds (1911), each with introduction, English prose translation, critical notes and commentary. Greek text facing, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling.

w-j-m-starkie-wasps-1897: The Wasps of Aristophanes, with introduction, metrical analysis, critical notes and commentary (London: Macmillan, 1897); Greek text with English commentary, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling
w-j-m-starkie-acharnians-1909: The Acharnians of Aristophanes, with introduction, English prose translation, critical notes and commentary (London: Macmillan, 1909); Greek text facing, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling
w-j-m-starkie-clouds-1911: The Clouds of Aristophanes, with introduction, English prose translation, critical notes and commentary, including a new transcript of the scholia in the Codex Venetus Marcianus 474 (London: Macmillan, 1911); Greek text facing, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling
